name: Parker Cole
degree: Bachelor of Science, Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
intro: I enjoy mechanical design, CAD, and building physical prototypes. At Peterbilt, I gained experience in advanced manufacturing engineering.
bio: I'm a Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering Student at Oklahoma State University, with a minor in Mathematics and a 4.00 GPA. I enjoy using CAD and manufacturing methods to build and improve physical prototypes.

I've designed custom putter prototypes in SolidWorks and worked with Creo Parametric during my internship at Peterbilt Motors Company. I'm looking for engineering internships where I can contribute to design, manufacturing, and prototyping while gaining more hands-on experience.

points: I supported the Chassis Powertrain and Cab & Outer Body groups on several advanced manufacturing engineering projects.
I created and modified 3D models in Creo Parametric and worked with engineers across different areas of the plant.
I developed an AI-assisted tool that reduced the time needed to find information in part drawings from about five minutes to one minute per drawing.
I managed concurrent projects, presented progress each week, and gave a final presentation to engineering leadership.
I was promoted from Mover to Navigator within two weeks.
I planned truck layouts and coordinated with teammates and customers to complete moves safely and on schedule.
I managed inventory, arranged and restocked merchandise, and helped customers while working with the store team.
